extracted.name: Linguine and Clam Sauce
extracted.description: This is a very easy and tasty recipe. My family loves it. Try serving it with a green salad and garlic bread if desired.
ingredient_lines: 2 (6.5 ounce) cans minced clams, drained with juice reserved
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain and reserve.
In a small saucepan over medium heat, warm oil, butter, reserved clam juice, garlic and parsley; stir and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add clams and salt and pepper to taste. Pour over pasta and toss with Parmesan cheese; serve.
